name: a point is not followed through a named net, so ground splits into many lines
find: + ["net:" + n for n in element.get("connected_source_net_ids") or []])

name: a part alone on an off-board supply vanishes
each ground pad is its own point
find: return "GND" if re.fullmatch(r"GND\d*", label) else label

name: a leg the record names is not said
a resistor's end does not say which resistor or what it is for
a point with more ends than a row holds is not sent to a rail
identical parts are not totalled
nothing your drawer holds for this project reads yours
what you own but have not held here reads to get
an entry the person set aside still counts
a project with nothing built gets no word of how to build it
a failed build is read as a good one
a build of other requirements is read as this one's
a CONFLICT is not said before power
find: lines += ["- **CONFLICT** on %s: %s" % (name, conflict) for conflict in part_rules.pull_conflicts(part)]

name: a pin that must not float is not said
find: lines += ["- %s %s: %s" % (name, pin["pin"], pin.get("note", "")) for pin in part.get("unused_pins") or []]

name: --out is ignored
find: out = Path(args.out) if args.out else requirements.resolve().parent / SHEET

name: --keep writes no breadboard sheet
a build that did not finish still writes a sheet from an earlier dist
find: why = why_not_built(stages, "board only: nothing to wire")

name: board lines sort as text, D10 before D3
a supply from off the board is not named on its line
find: line += " · the %s supply, from off the board, not part of the parts list" % supply

name: a record's warnings repeat for each instance of the part
the board's ground pads are said once per pad
find: ends = list(dict.fromkeys(end(component, port) for component, port in point.members))
replace: ends = [end(component, port) for component, port in point.members]

name: a build that recorded nothing is read as finished
a build of other requirements (the board swapped) is read as this one's
a signal the requirements add is not said
find: lines += (["", "Not wired:", ""] + unwired) if unwired else []

name: equal resistors are not totalled
a supply from off the board is not said before power
a sheet from an earlier build is left beside a build that did not finish
a breadboard row is taken to hold six
